design.hypothesis: Extra causal acceleration/variability features, stronger linear regularization and constrained absolute-loss boosting may improve consistency on near-flat gauges.
design.selection: Two training-only expanding 168h folds with timestamp-based 78h embargo. Require pooled MAE gain >=5%, nonworse fold MAE and pooled RMSE; select minimum CV RMSE, assess once on saved selection.
design.rain: Existing frozen water/rain schema; no imputation, no new source mapping.
design.independent_evaluation: NOT_EVALUATED; saved holdout already inspected, no promotion from these results.
